title: Each value is the sum of the three just before it, so one left-to-right pass fills the line
caption: ways(n) for the staircase with steps of 1, 2 or 3, for n = 0..7. ways(0) = 1, and n < 0 counts 0.

frames.text: Base cases: ways(0) = 1 (stand still), ways(1) = 1, ways(2) = 1 + 1 = 2.
ways(5) = ways(4) + ways(3) + ways(2) = 7 + 4 + 2 = 13. The last move was 1, 2 or 3 stairs, and those three groups of ways don't overlap.
ways(7) = 24 + 13 + 7 = 44. Only the three values in the window are ever read, which is why three variables are enough.
